· The firm must have experience of having successfully completed “Similar Work” of successfull y supplying one no. steel hull vessel registered under M.S. Act or I.V. Act (maintained under class of an I ACS approved Classification Society) with experience manning during the last 7 years up to March-2026, which should be in the following manner: - 1 (one) similar completed work costing not less than 80% of the estimated value of Rs. 885 Lakhs which equals to Rs.708 Lakhs (including GST). or 2 (two) similar completed works each costing not less than 50% of the estimated value of Rs. 885 Lakhs ea ch which equals Rs.442.5 Lakhs (including GST). or 3 (three) similar completed works each costing not less than 40% of the estimated value of Rs.885 Lakhs each which equals to Rs.354 Lakhs (including GST). Similar Work” means successfully supplying and/or Manning, Operating, maintaining (MOM) of at least one steel hull vessel registered under M.S. Act or I.V. Act (maintained under Class of an IACS approved Classification Society). · Claims for fulfilling the above criteria must be adequately supported by the relevant Agreement/Work o rder and Performance Certificate from the previous contract/work ordering entity to establish the credibi lity. Authentic Performance Certificate of similar previous works carried out mentioning valu e of work and period of work to be submitted. · The bidder must submit the copies of TDS Certificates including Form 26AS, for the entire p eriod of work, in support of value of work mentioned in the Performance Certificate/Complet ion Certificate. Self-attested & stamped copies to upload. · The average annual financial turnover of the firm during the last 3 years ending 31st March 2026 shoul d be at least Rs.265 Lakh (including GST) to be duly certified by Chartered Accountant mentioning UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number). Self-attested & stamped copy to upload. · TDS Certificate including Form 26AS, Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss A/c of the bidding entity along with schedules and audit report, for last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) duly certified by Ch artered Accountant mentioning UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number). Self-attested & st amped copies to upload. The Certificate of CA needs to be taken from Statutory Auditor and no t any CA. · If the bidding entity is a Joint Venture/Consortium, they shall submit documents to establish that they j ointly meet the eligibility criteria. Each member of the bidding entity of joint venture/Consortium shall al so submit Company’s Form 26AS, Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss A/c along with schedules and audit report, for last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) duly certified by Chartered Accountant ment ioning UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number). · EMD of Rs.17,70,000/- (Rupees Seventeen Lakhs Seventy Thousand) only, payable to “Sya ma Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata” through RTGS/NEFT or vide alternative modes as detail ed at clause no.5 of the NIT. A photocopy of the successful transaction report must be uploa ded in their offer through GeM Portal https://gem.gov.in The original EMD instrument shall b e submitted within 3 working days from the closing of online submission of tender. · MSEs interested in availing exemption of Tender document fee and EMD benefits must encl ose with their offer the Udyam Registration Certificate with the Udyam Registration Number,

as per Clause 5. (e), as proof of their being registered under Udyam Registration Portal. Th e certificate shall be of latest but before the deadline for submission of the bid. · Where the bidder does not possess the launch, the owner of the launch should be one of t he members of Joint Venture/Consortium and should fulfill the condition of JV of the NIT as a pplicable. · In case of Joint Venture/ Consortium ,i) All members must submit documents as per clause 2.2 a), b), c), d), e), f),h), i),o), p), & q) . · Support/ Preferential Treatment to Micro& Small Enterprises (MSEs): i) In case of Micro and Small Enterprise (MSEs) holding valid UDYAM certificate with registrat ion number, indicating the list of activity related to the subject tender as per National Indu strial Classification -2008 (revised list 2025) mentioned in the table below a) shall become eligible for exemption from payment of EMD. b) Purchase preference will be given as per Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Mic ro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. Sl No. Code / Sub-c Code / Sub-clas Description lass as per s as per 2025 2008 1 Sub-class 3011 Sub -Class Building of ships and floating s 1,30112 tructures 301101,301102 2 Sub-class 5222 Sub-class 522201 Service activities incidental to 0 ,522202, 522203 water transportation ii) If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Service Provider (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% o f margin of purchase preference /price band as defined in the relevant policy, then 100% order quantity will be awarded to such MSE bidder subject to acceptance of L1 bid price. S uch bidder shall also upload the scanned copy of valid & relevant certificate. iii) Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Polic y. NB : · If the bidder wants to supply ready built launch then to avail MSE benefit the bi dder must have any one of the code as mentioned in Sl No. 2. In the absence of t he code the bidder would consider as non-MSE category for this instant tender an d needs to submit the EMD amount else the bid would be considered as non-resp onsive and summarily rejected. · If the bidder wants to construct and supply the launch then to avail MSE benefit the bidder must have one code each from Sl No 1 & 2. In the absence of the codes the bidder would consider as non-MSE category for this instant tender and needs to submit the EMD amount else the bid would be considered as non-responsive a nd summarily rejected. Please ignore weight of the Vessel in the Additional Details as 200 Ton, refer NIT (GRT would be 32 Ton minimum).
